plugins.photosPermission: MyVerein needs access to your photos so you can choose a profile photo. It is also used for photos in damage reports, for membership applications (profile photo, attached photos) and proof documents when founding a club.
plugins.cameraPermission: MyVerein needs access to the camera so you can take a photo for your profile or a membership application.

extra.description: MyVerein ist die Vereinsverwaltung für Mitglieder, Vorstand und externe Kontakte.
